title: AI built me a Quake 3 style shooter with multiplayer + voice chat. We can recreate our favorite games on weekends now
author: oksowhaat
selftext:
We can now recreate our favorite games. This is Three.js + Claude (Fable 5), a couple days of work.

Quake-style arena with jetpacks and rail guns that shoot through everyone in line, AI bots that grab weapons, run to heal, and fight each other for the top spot. Single/Multiplayer + voice chat.

The new aproach that SOTA AI models bring: I just dropped a low-poly asset folder in and said what I wanted. It sorted out the models, textures, animations and built the whole map on its own and I never opened Blender. 

In-browser, no install:  
[https://sky-cruiser-9065b31330ea.herokuapp.com](https://sky-cruiser-9065b31330ea.herokuapp.com/) 

Happy to share details if anyone's curious.
